subject.title: Control UI: full-page New session screen with host directory browser

question: Should Control UI expose an admin-only arbitrary gateway-host directory browser as part of the new-session screen, or should the redesign retain typed paths?
rationale: The routed screen is roadmap-aligned UX work, but enumerating host directories and following symlinks creates a new information-disclosure boundary not settled by the existing sessions.create cwd permission.

options.title: Approve scoped host browser
options.body: Add the routed screen and a read-only admin RPC with explicit gateway-host semantics, deterministic directory-only results, and reviewed symlink and error-disclosure rules.

options.title: Ship UI redesign only
options.body: Replace the modal with the full-page draft but retain the existing admin-only absolute-path input until filesystem browsing policy is settled.

options.title: Keep current flow
options.body: Leave the modal and text input unchanged if the additional route and host API are not worth the ongoing surface area.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped host browser
recommendation.body: Add the routed screen and a read-only admin RPC with explicit gateway-host semantics, deterministic directory-only results, and reviewed symlink and error-disclosure rules.
